# Interior Design Skill for Muse

Consumer-side coordination for interior projects — renovation planning, furniture selection, material math, rental optimization, staging. It runs on discipline, not inspiration: no dimensions, no specifics — it demands real room measurements, door/entry fit checks, and supplier localization to your country before recommending anything; locks to one price tier so proposals stay coherent; sequences work in hard order (structural → electrical → surfaces → furniture → decor); and frames rental staging as ROI with photo-first thinking. Project memory lives in local files (`~/Clawic/data/interior-design/`). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a coordination framework, not a shopping agent — it never buys, never contacts suppliers, never infers your style from silence, and works only from your measurements and photos. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
